name: Dairy milk silk roast almond
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Roasted Almonds (19%*), Milk Solids (18%*), Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Solids, Fractionated Fat, Emulsifiers (442, 476), Flavours (Natural, Nature Identical and Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances). Contains Cocoa Butter Equivalent in addition to Cocoa Butter. Allergen Information: Contains Milk, Almonds, Soy. May Contain Tree Nuts, Wheat, Barley.
